# Capital Pro Pressure Washing

> Professional exterior cleaning in New York's Capital Region — soft wash house washing, roof washing, concrete and paver cleaning and sealing, gutters, windows, and holiday lighting. Serving Albany, Schenectady, Saratoga Springs, Troy, Clifton Park, and Rensselaer. Call (518) 900-1913.

Family-run, 10+ years in business, licensed and insured, with free no-obligation quotes and military and first-responder discounts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Services overview, before/after gallery, reviews, service area, and FAQs.
- [Free Quote](/#quote): Request a free exterior cleaning quote.

## Services

- [House Washing](/house-washing): Low-pressure soft wash siding cleaning that removes mold, algae, and dirt.
- [Roof Washing](/roof-washing): Soft wash black-streak (Gloeocapsa magma), moss, and lichen removal with a 2-year no-streak guarantee.
- [Roof Rejuvenation](/roof-rejuvenation): Asphalt shingle rejuvenation treatment backed by a 6-year warranty.
- [Concrete Cleaning & Sealing](/concrete-cleaning-sealing): Driveway, walkway, and stamped concrete cleaning, antiquing color restoration, and sealing.
- [Paver Cleaning & Sealing](/paver-cleaning-sealing): Paver patio and walkway cleaning, polymeric re-sanding, and sealing.
- [Deck & Patio Cleaning](/deck-patio-cleaning): Safe wood and composite deck and patio cleaning.
- [Gutter Cleaning](/gutter-cleaning): Interior gutter cleanout and exterior gutter brightening.
- [Gutter Guards](/gutter-guards): Gutter guard installation to stop clogs.
- [Window Cleaning](/window-cleaning): Exterior window cleaning, typically paired with a house wash.
- [Fence Cleaning](/fence-cleaning): Vinyl and wood fence washing.
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](/commercial-pressure-washing): Storefronts, sidewalks, dumpster pads, and multi-unit properties.
- [Holiday Lighting](/holiday-lighting): Seasonal Christmas light design, install, and takedown.
- [Permanent Lighting](/permanent-lighting): Year-round permanent architectural lighting.
